technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with overbought conditions limiting upside probability; RSI14 rising and trend-following indicators bullish, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with weak volume confirmation.

fundamental.summary: HAS shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 79 days.

sentiment.summary: No current congressional signal; market in fear zone (43/100) with bearish sentiment (40%) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (2+ years old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (247.8) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 79 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI14 rising with supertrend and hull bullish signals suggest early momentum inflection, and fear-zone sentiment (43/100) presents contrarian opportunity near support at 52.97.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 247.8), price trapped below both 50-SMA and EMA-50, overbought oscillators without volume confirmation, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings event risk in 79 days create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: RSI14 rising with supertrend/hull bullish signals and fear-zone sentiment (43/100) suggest early momentum inflection at support (52.97). However, severe macro headwinds, overbought oscillators without volume confirmation, and zero fundamental conviction create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis (247.8), and earnings event in 79 days create macro event risk; price trapped below 50-SMA/EMA-50 with negative CMF/AO signals weak institutional support for rally.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
